lines.label: M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.

events.text:
Two base cells placed side-by-side at 0,0,0 and 1,0,0 with a notch drawer frame filling the empty triangular gap that touches both - the drawer position beside both bases at 0,1,0 (notch:0#0,1#notch1, stem hex-drawer-frame-notch-fm). No additional bases or half bases added. View confirms side-by-side bases with drawer frame seated in the shared empty spot. No caps/joint bolts added to respect "nothing else structural" limit.

**Requirements:**
- Two bases side by side: **met** - piece:0,0,0;full and piece:1,0,0;full adjacent at q=0 and q=1
- Nothing else structural: no more bases or half bases: **met** - build contains only those 2 piece parts, no additional piece placements
- Add a drawer that fills the empty spot beside both of them: **met** - notch:0#0,1#notch1 (hex-drawer-frame-notch-fm) fills the empty position between the two cells at 0,1,0, providing integrated drawer; verified by check_build meshClash clear and get_build counts

Build passes configurator checks (meshClash clear, only expected STABILITY_TIP warning for tipped drawer geometry). Caps/joint-bolts omitted to honour "nothing else structural" constraint.
